200.description: The stored draft, without its document.

workflowId.description: The workflow id the draft belongs to.

version.description: The revision number of the draft.

status.description: A stored revision's lifecycle: `published` is served, `draft` is only reachable pinned, `retired` refuses to run.

allOf.description: A stored revision's lifecycle: `published` is served, `draft` is only reachable pinned, `retired` refuses to run.
allOf.title: WorkflowVersionStatus

name.description: The family's display label, or null when it has none.

400.description:
The body or query violates its declared shape; `message` names each violated rule.

`WORKFLOW_INVALID`: The document fails the DDL; `reason` names the rule and `path`, when the failure can be located, the offending place.

oneOf.description: NestJS's default error envelope, returned where the framework answers instead of the engine: request validation (`400`, `message` lists each violated rule), the admin bearer guard (`401`, `403`, `503`), and a `500` on the submit and provider-callback routes where a connector adapter fails with a plain error rather than a coded refusal.
oneOf.title: NestHttpError

allOf.description: The engine's own error envelope. `code` is the stable identifier a client branches on; `message` repeats it. A code that adds detail properties is described on the operation that returns it.
allOf.title: ApiError

401.description: No bearer token, or the token fails signature, issuer, audience or expiry verification.

409.description:
`WORKFLOW_VERSION_NOT_DRAFT`: The revision is not a draft; carries `workflowId`, `version` and `status`.

`WORKFLOW_DRAFT_IN_USE`: An onboarding references this draft; carries `workflowId` and `version`.

`WORKFLOW_VERSION_EXISTS`: A revision with this workflow id and version already exists; carries `workflowId` and `version`.

`WORKFLOW_DRAFT_EXISTS`: The workflow already has a draft; carries `workflowId` and `draftVersion`.

`WORKFLOW_SCOPE_CONFLICT`: The workflow id belongs to a family in another scope; carries `workflowId` and `scope`.

503.description: Entra's signing key set could not be reached, so the token was never judged. Retry.
